scenarios.scenario: Malformed entries must not be overwritten
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration

scenarios.scenario: Deeply nested TOML must stop at its parser cap
scenarios.evidence_scope: unit

scenarios.scenario: Missing arguments and empty names must fail before mutation
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration

scenarios.scenario: An argument beyond the OS exec size limit must not be mistaken for success
scenarios.evidence_scope: Not directly tested; OS ARG_MAX differs. Large valid inputs are covered by SC2/FA2.

scenarios.scenario: Concurrent first writers must preserve every committed entry
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration

scenarios.scenario: Terminating a lock waiter must preserve state and permit later writes
scenarios.evidence_scope: portable campaign + ASan

scenarios.scenario: A stalled Git helper must time out and leave no partial installed plugin
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration; offline fake transport

scenarios.scenario: An unreachable restore remote must roll back newly created checkouts
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration; local Git fixtures

scenarios.scenario: Restoring entries must keep paired encrypted values consistent
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration

scenarios.scenario: Hard termination must expose a valid old or new store
scenarios.evidence_scope: portable campaign + ASan; 20 seeded kill delays, exact phase uncontrolled

scenarios.scenario: Private secret-cache paths must reject unsafe permissions
scenarios.evidence_scope: unit; local filesystem access boundary, no remote auth service

scenarios.scenario: Run-only secrets must stay out of fresh shell exports
scenarios.evidence_scope: candidate trial; fixture secrets/file backend

scenarios.scenario: Synced ciphertext with preserved older mtime can leave a stale session cache
scenarios.evidence_scope: Documented limit in docs/security-review.md and config reference; no stronger invalidation guarantee claimed.

scenarios.scenario: Watched files appearing and disappearing must trigger changes
scenarios.evidence_scope: unit; no calendar/DST dependence in monotonic subprocess deadlines

scenarios.scenario: Large TOML documents must parse without a fixed arena overflow
scenarios.evidence_scope: unit; bounded correctness test, not load benchmarking

scenarios.scenario: Large stdin with simultaneous stderr output must not deadlock or exceed capture bounds
scenarios.evidence_scope: unit; 1 MiB input and 100 KiB output

scenarios.scenario: Real ENOSPC must fail without replacing the live store and permit recovery
scenarios.evidence_scope: Linux failure-campaign job; actual ENOSPC, not EFBIG

scenarios.scenario: An error during a partial atomic write must preserve the prior store
scenarios.evidence_scope: portable campaign + ASan; kernel RLIMIT_FSIZE/EFBIG

scenarios.scenario: A published binary upgrade must preserve the first new shell and encrypted values
scenarios.evidence_scope: previous-release upgrade job; zsh/bash/fish on both OSes

scenarios.scenario: Opt-in v1-to-v2 migration must retain values and restore rewrapping
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration; v2 stays experimental

scenarios.scenario: Dry-run and missing confirmation must not mutate stores or run hooks
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration

scenarios.scenario: Pasted text, Unicode and quoted values must survive input and fresh sessions
scenarios.evidence_scope: TUI job; candidate trial additionally checks Unicode/quoted values

scenarios.scenario: Relative config/data overrides must be rejected before writing
scenarios.evidence_scope: ordinary + ASan integration

scenarios.scenario: A read-only data directory must fail without corruption and recover after permissions return
scenarios.evidence_scope: portable campaign + ASan; refuses to misreport a root run as a permission test
